inclusion_rule: Include studies that compress ultrasound tongue images (with or without lip images) into feature vectors for recognition, synthesis or articulatory mapping by DCT, PCA/EigenTongues, autoencoders or learned CNN encoders. Boundary: exclude contour-only tracking without a feature vector used downstream, raw-image end-to-end models with no stated feature stage, and reviews; count versions once.
